## First genuine Asterinas-side HOS2 ioctl implementation candidate (read-only)

This is **A05 Draft**, not an assertion of G1. The current kernel still does **not** implement trusted CapSpace, process-start/exec-epoch lifecycle, ResourceDomain CAS, InstallBudget, ReadUsage, QueryDelivery, RetireThrough or Hepta durable effects.

**Source:** independent branch `agents/A05-native-queryabi-bootstrap` at commit `5fc3887dfc5833b61d11280eb1421bb7fd78648f`, pinned base `8f3bb49ab161104063a6ebea25428c40aa884ac0`. Exactly 4 files; **README remains zero bytes**:
- `kernel/asterinas/kernel/core/src/device/misc/hepta_control.rs`: restricted root-only devtmpfs char device `/dev/hepta-control` using Asterinas' existing char registry and `PerOpenFileOps::ioctl`; canonical HOS2 64-byte QueryAbi decode/112-byte response encoding via the **same** `libs/os-abi/src/lib.rs` source, not a second wire implementation. Allocates per-open temporary unique observation IDs, advertises **only** the QueryAbi operation. Invalid descriptor/request rejected without effect; all other ioctls ENOTTY.
- `kernel/asterinas/kernel/core/src/{lib.rs,device/misc/mod.rs}`: minimal device registration and shared codec path.
- `tests/kernel/control/queryabi_guest.c`: **compiled** statically linked x86_64 Linux ELF; checks actual ioctl response format, stable boot identity, per-open space-ID isolation, malformed magic EINVAL, NULL transport EFAULT, unknown ioctl ENOTTY.

**Actual build evidence:** fixed upstream `nightly-2026-07-21` full `make kernel` compiled successfully using pinned Asterinas v0.19.0. Produced kernel ELF **SHA256 `54c8a7a798cbbd80f1a8ce5f0144328815e63b413e79b0133206bcaaba607e4a`**, size 8,352,152B. Guest C probe compiled with `cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -static`. Build records are retained in authorized dev environment `/home/qian-qi/.local/state/trillionnium-os-organ-next-20261016/evidence/a05-native-queryabi-build-03/` and `-launch.log`.

**Known build-environment issue:** main's pre-existing A01 `support/build/kernel.sh` invokes `make --version | head -1`/`gcc --version | head -1` under `set -o pipefail`; one attempt exited SIGPIPE 141 before compilation. For the successful private build only, replaced `head -1` with non-early-terminating `sed -n '1p'`; **reverted that A01-owned file before commit**. The PR changes no A01 build inputs or Cargo.lock.

**Missing validation / genuine blockers:** an attempted custom QEMU QueryAbi guest runner and subsequent direct QEMU smoke were refused by the authorized execution channel. No successful kernel QueryAbi ioctl was executed; the C test is **compiled but not run as guest**. Full kernel boot from this particular new ELF, malformed kernel usercopy, fork/exec, authorization and production behavior all remain **NOT TESTED**. Do not mark G1 complete from compilation or from the Linux host QueryAbi/ENOTTY test.

**Review instructions:** A05/A00 should next run the compiled guest probe in a disposable pinned one-vCPU QEMU initramfs, verify magic/version/op-mask/boot ID/fd ownership/error cases and measure copyout on EFAULT. Before considering main, replace the provisional per-open space ID with genuine trusted CapSpace session binding, publish a stable allocated ioctl number through A00, and use an explicit Cargo path dependency/lock arrangement for the canonical HOS2 crate if appropriate. This Draft adds *no effect authority*. Existing Hepta `TrustedReadOnlyOrganV1` remains I/O-free.

structuredContent.body:
First real kernel implementation attempt, intentionally DRAFT until pinned Rust compilation and the previously committed Asterinas guest CPU probe pass.

Changes (exact source in branch):
- Extend existing cgroup CPU controller with TSC-based period/runtime accounting, ancestor checks and throttle counters. Reconfiguration preserves already-used runtime.
- Charge the common ClassScheduler current task on scheduler events; test eligibility in both real-time and fair queues; park throttled tasks and restore them from local idle ticks. Reuse cgroup state, not a parallel HOS2 ledger. No scheduler hot-injection or model calls.
- Small A01 build-tool correction: remove `make --version | head -1` / `gcc --version | head -1` pipes under `set -o pipefail` after observing SIGPIPE 141 before any kernel compilation.

**Not claimed:** verified CPU enforcement, SMP correctness, parent/scheduler migration correctness, kernel build, Hepta effects, or API stabilization. We will retain raw build/boot/probe evidence, fix compile and semantic issues here, and not merge if regressions exist. Work is restricted to disposable QEMU and isolated source worktree; no production host cgroup, disk, services or firmware changed. Root README remains 0 bytes.

Baseline failing case in merged tests: 1% `cpu.max=1000 100000` written/read back but guest still used ~998ms CPU per 1000ms wall. Success requires low actual CPU consumption, bounded error and no deadlocks/panics in the **modified** kernel with independent probe.

## A04 Linux userland compatibility baseline

This draft PR records reproducible original-Linux behavior, fixed rootfs/workload inputs, fixed-commit Hepta evidence, guarded QEMU replay, and the first real Asterinas guest capability probe. It does not claim full Debian13 ELF compatibility or authenticated Hepta W1 completion.

### Current head and inputs

- Branch: agents/A04-linux-hepta-baseline
- Current head: 17558f66a8de10ed51ca2e193f567540168c15a7
- Base: main 47288c4465720d125658b392efc655b333c90868
- Hepta source: f8c9419df6ddeb36ff8b522a50219981fb8d9345
- Rootfs manifest SHA-256: 55aa8369d4f912267139ef7626c752814d7dc833e49accc337529f2545fb94cb
- USTAR SHA-256: df8df2e3cdcd308ef62a59268a4519e2923c9ff78145e46f26a4092725e80797
- Catalog SHA-256: 64b268956848d4fd97c6ace51343d607f20495d7bd317491a5bf7ead5e672db0

### Evidence

- Host workload tests: 87 OK / 6 managed-host skips, also under python3 -O; catalog 31 pass + 1 Tokio not_run.
- Original Linux chroot/staged C ELF: 28/28; five-round stress: 90/90; SQLite WAL source workaround passes.
- QEMU 8.2.2 and accepted SeaBIOS booted the A01 kernel/initramfs under TCG and exited 33.
- Guest capability probe: 13 cases, 11 pass. Pathname/abstract AF_UNIX and peer credentials pass in guest.
- Real guest gaps: MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC leaves FD_CLOEXEC clear; RLIMIT_NOFILE soft=32 still permits 256 opens without EMFILE.
- Evidence contract regression: test_guest_qemu_evidence.py locks the 13-case result, focused followups, and exact-rootfs fail-closed status.
- Exact Debian13 package/sysroot reconstruction was attempted without system installation; all four rebuilt ELF hashes differ from the manifest. Evidence: exact-rootfs-input-recheck-20261017.json.

### Remaining owners

- A05: implement MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC ancillary receive handling and RLIMIT_NOFILE/EMFILE enforcement.
- A06: retain passing futex/thread/signal/robust-owner-death probes.
- A07: supply authenticated provider composition and independent terminal tool-effect receipt.
- A00/A01: supply original rootfs tar and four manifest-pinned ELF files for full replay.

All changed files remain under compat/linux/**, support/rootfs/**, tests/workloads/linux/**; root README.md remains empty.

issue.title: A06 G1 CPU accounting: settle final Task runtime after Process weak-reference teardown
issue.body:
## Source-grounded G1 correctness blocker — not yet reproduced as QEMU undercharge

Current A06 `kernel/asterinas/kernel/core/src/fs/fs_impls/cgroupfs/controller/cpu.rs` (inspected blob `45d93fe11506e6f6813142de1012352b958a5897`) implements `charge_task_cpu(task, from, until)` by `thread.weak_process().upgrade()`; when the Process Arc is already gone, it **returns without charging any positive pending CPU interval**. This avoids the earlier SMP `unwrap(None)` panic, but may lose final scheduler runtime and undercount the original cgroup and its ancestors for short-lived tasks.

This is a concrete source-level accounting/lifetime concern, **not a demonstrated quota-bypass exploit**. The owner's 153/153 kernel tests and 2vCPU guest results do not isolate final per-task debit after Process destruction.

### Required A06 correction and exact validation
- Retain a strong reference to the *original* accounting cgroup/ResourceDomain through task exit or settle current runtime before Process ownership disappears. Do not guess a replacement domain or build a second ResourceDomain/ledger.
- Debit `[from, until)` once, bounded and IRQ-safe, across preemption, task exit, dequeue and reaping, including shared ancestor, FIFO/fair and 100ms boundary.
- Add a deterministic negative regression for `Weak<Process>` being dead with pending CPU runtime, plus disposable 1vCPU and 2vCPU high-rate worker/fork/exit QEMU workloads checking actual cpu.stat versus independent process/guest CPU consumption and no panic.
- Keep A06 [Draft #18](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop/pull/18) unqualified for G1 until proven and connected to A05 genuine CapSpace. No production host cgroup/firmware/disk changes.

A00 reported the source path and requirement in #18 review; this issue tracks the executable negative acceptance, not an additional administrative gate.
